suggestions: Pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
Reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
reached_sql:
WITH mv AS (
    SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_promo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, p_channel_email, p_channel_event, d_year
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    JOIN promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    AND (p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N')
    AND d_year = 2001
)
SELECT i_item_id, avg(ss_quantity) AS agg1, avg(ss_list_price) AS agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 
FROM mv
JOIN item ON mv.ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id
ORDER BY i_item_id
LIMIT 100
